svg.title: Mac — Listening and attention
svg.desc: Original static settings design. Synthetic labels and source-default previews only; no runtime queries, audio, configuration writes or app behavior.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Text, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Choose when the station should listen and which follow-ups may receive attention.
Effective state not queried. Proposed controls require supported host capabilities.
Microphone stays off until you explicitly start on a confirmed target.
A preset reviews its exact changes before applying. It never starts capture.
Relaxes cues for eligible uncertain follow-ups. Confident ignore still stays ignored.
Default off. Only affects eligible follow-ups from the engaged speaker.
Default 0.40 · greater than 0 and at most 1.
Default unset. A configured probability can waive the extra cue check.
Default off. Applies only to selected-attend speech after a reply starts.
Optional 0–1. Below this bar, an attend decision becomes uncertain.
Section absent means off; an enabled section needs trusted local model assets.
Tentative must be greater than 0 and below bind; neither is authentication.
Default 2,000 ms · 0–5,000 ms. Zero disables joining.
Edit every supported member, aliases and thresholds in the technical index.
Continue in All settings for every field, source and prerequisite. This frame shows representative controls.
